info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Margins Retrieval API
info.description: The Credit Margins Retrieval API provides access to detailed credit margin information for specified banking models. This API allows users to query and retrieve real-time margin calculations, which are essential for assessing credit risk and financial performance. Typical consumers include financial analysts, risk management teams, and banking application developers who require insights into credit margin parameters. By leveraging this endpoint, users can ensure informed decision-making regarding lending practices and financial strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve credit margin details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific credit margin identified by its unique ID. It provides insights into various attributes and values associated with the credit margin, allowing for informed financial decisions.
